correctness.rationale: Fixed recovery equations yield x2=gamma and independent G_i(x_i)=d_i with G_i=x-A_i x^2 exp(-Kx); each derivative has at most two positive zeros, giving at most 3 positive roots per outer neuron. Reconstructed full six-variable Jacobian characteristic determinant Q1 Q2 Q3-(lambda-a)(lambda-1)(s1 t1 Q3+s3 t3 Q1). At lambda=1 the two G_i derivatives determine the sign, and with two descending branches the largest >1 root of a Q_i forces a real spectral root >1; at most two ascending roots per outer neuron can be sinks. At rational witness the three root positions are 0.0020489380177,0.0923303627250,2.1888643904714; independent full Jacobian eigensolver across all nine pairs gives precisely four spectral radii <1 (about 0.9141) and five >1 (about 1.8587). Read original check.py exact-rational exponential enclosure and Rouché strict 0.00011239816 < 0.0005184; the rigorous universal result comes from sign/root arguments, not the numerical eigenvalue check. At folds eigenvalue 1 excludes hyperbolic sinks. No global basin theorem.
